evidence.title: CSS Toggle Library — Pure-CSS Switches & Checkboxes

name: CSS Toggle Library
summary: Library of 36 pure-CSS toggles, switches, checkboxes and radios to copy — no JavaScript, no dependencies.
description: A copy-and-paste collection of 36 toggle switches, checkboxes and radios built with pure CSS. Click any toggle to view and copy its self-contained CSS, or grab a ready-made prompt to have a coding agent recreate it; each snippet defines its own theme tokens and respects prefers-reduced-motion.
